name: Tapeory
description: Design, store, and print Brother P-touch labels from your browser. Tapeory is a self-hosted web app for label templates: design a label in the browser editor, add named fields like "Name" or "Room", and fill them in when you print. You can also import existing P-touch Editor .lbx files. Requires a MySQL 8 or MariaDB database, for example Unraid's "mariadb" template. Create an empty database and a user, then enter the connection in the web UI on first start. Printing supports 34 Brother P-touch (PT) and QL label printers, from the PT-P750W and PT-P900 series to the QL-500 through QL-1115NWB. After the database setup you create the first account, the administrator; more accounts can be added as administrators or users.

paths.name: Storage Path
paths.description: Templates, uploads, rendered labels, backups, and the saved database connection. Back this up regularly.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the Tapeory web UI and API are served on.

variables.name: Database Connection String
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to enter the database connection in the web UI on first start (it's saved to the storage path). If set, e.g. server=192.168.1.10;port=3306;database=tapeory;user=tapeory;password=CHANGE_ME; it overrides that and the setup screen is skipped.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the storage path; the app runs as this user. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the storage path. Unraid default: 100 (users).

variables.name: Auto Migrate Database
variables.description: Automatically apply pending database migrations on container start.
